profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Optum Insight
profile.summary:
Experienced software engineering leader with excellent design, architecture, operational and coding skills. Passionately finds creative, efficient and cost-effective solutions to business problems using software and technology. Likes to blend existing products into new solutions. Likes to leverage the latest technology to create cheaper and better solutions at both the macro and micro scale. Provides unvarnished, quality technical and solution advice to senior leadership. Loves to help others succeed. Combines technical and leadership skills to get things done by overcoming business, people, logistical and technical problems of all kinds. Always willing to invest time and energy in learning new technology to determine if that technology can be leveraged to improve existing solutions or create new solutions. Enjoys collaborating with Business, IT Operations, InfoSec and DevOps staff to design and implement the complete solution including application, networking, security, monitoring, logging, storage, support staff, training, CI/CD and BC/DR.

• Creative Thinker – There was a box?
• Holistic approach to solutions. Uses the big picture to understand the details. And uses the details to understand the big picture.
• Designs for security and performance first rather than trying to retrofit later. Understands low-level encryption and security technology, federated security (SAML, OpenID), and other security concerns.
• Understands the implications to design and technology choices when building large scale applications.
• Provides technical, process and people leadership to get the best out of teams.
• Broad and deep experience building applications in all environments and scales. From desktop to tablets to mobile to traditional server farms to cloud native.
• Experienced in automating deployments and creating install packages.
• Understands the principles and implementation of networking, databases, SAAS, MicroSAAS, Single Page App (SPA), SOA, REST API design and implementation, authentication, authorization and other technical details.
• Experienced Manager
• Extensive experience blending cloud services (serverless) to create new applications and augment existing applications. Very experienced with AWS RDS, s3, EC2, ELB, Lambda, AWS APIs, etc.
• Proficient in C# (including latest .NET CORE) [10+ years], C++ [25+ years], Javascript [20+ years], Database (MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server) [15-30 years], and a random assortment of scripting languages, SDKs and tools.

positions.description: People and Technical leader for multiple customer-facing products with design, budget and technical responsibilities (40+ FTEs and contractors). Remediated important customer-facing application (2011) and provided consistent growth and support for applications.

positions.title: Development Manager
positions.description: Emdeon/WebMD, People and Technical leader for multiple customer-facing products (20+ FTEs plus contractors) including Clinician, ClinicianRx and WebMD Office SAAS products with annual revenues over $30+ million and many thousands of customers and users. Led team through difficult rebuild/remediation of WebMD Office (2002). Led team through creation and delivery of Clinician Rx into production in 90 days (2006). Led team to achieve Meaningful Use certification for Clinician (2009).
